span.p:
Step-by-step:
1. Entry "E" arrives
2. Cache is full (maxmemory reached)
3. Policy selects tail entry "D" (oldest access)
4. "D" is removed from list and hash map
5. "E" is inserted at head (most recently used)
6. Memory is now below limit
